preconditions.description: The number of queries q must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= type_i <= 2 for type_i in types)
preconditions.description: Each query type must be either 1 or 2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= current_vertex_count for v_i in vertices)
preconditions.description: Each vertex index v_i must be valid and already exist before the query.

postconditions.description: The output must match the expected values for each query of type 2.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(a - b) <= 1e-6 for a, b in zip(output_values, expected_values))
postconditions.description: The absolute or relative error of the output values must not exceed 10^-6.

invariants.description: The count of vertices must always match the length of the vertices list.

invariants.expression: all(v in vertices for v in vertices)
invariants.description: All vertex indices must be present in the vertices list.
